page_title: Tercana — Live subtitle translator for PS Remote Play on Mac

sources.entry: Tercana - Menu bar companion for PS5 Remote Play: live on-device subtitle translation into any language, plus a PSN trophy tracker. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Rumpony/Tercana) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Tercana
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app that reads on-screen subtitles from PS Remote Play and translates them live on-device, plus a built-in PSN trophy tracker.
use_cases: Reading translated subtitles while streaming PS5 or PS4 games via Remote Play
Translating subtitles in videos into another language
Tracking PSN trophies, rarity and platinum progress on a Mac
Keeping game translation private without cloud services
summary.what_it_does: Tercana lets you pick a subtitle area on screen once, then recognizes new subtitle lines and translates them in under a second, overlaid over the original text. It skips button prompts and HUD text and highlights speaker names. A shortcut (Ctrl+Option+L) can also handle letters, menus and item descriptions. Recognition and translation run on the Mac using Apple's on-device translation, with no cloud processing. It also includes a trophy view with statistics, per-trophy rarity badges, closest-to-platinum tracking, pinned goals with notes, and links to PSNProfiles, PowerPyx and YouTube guides.
notable: Live on-device subtitle translation for PS Remote Play, with nothing sent to the cloud
Built-in PSN trophy tracker with rarity badges and platinum tracking
DualSense battery shown in menu bar with low-battery warnings
Supports over 20 languages from Apple's on-device translation
caveats: Trophy features need an internet connection; translation works offline once the language pack is downloaded
Not affiliated with PSNProfiles or PowerPyx
